content: नयनम् [नी-करणे ल्युट्] .²1 Leading, guiding, conducting managing. .²2 Taking, bringing to or near, drawing; पापापहं स्वर्नयनं दुस्तरं पार्थिवर्षभैः <ls>Rām. 1. 14. 58</ls>. .²3 Ruling, governing, polity; वाक्यैः पवित्रार्थपदैर्नयनैः प्राकृतैरपि <ls>Bhāg. 10. 50. 34</ls>. .²4 Obtaining. .²5 The eye. .²6 Passing, spending (as time). .{@-ना, नी@} The pupil of the eye.
